description: This file contains implementation of the QuicStreamFactoryPeer class, providing testing utilities and accessors for QuicStreamFactory objects in the Chromium project, including session management, configuration, and mock setup functions.

classes.name: QuicStreamFactoryPeer
classes.description: A testing utility class providing accessors and manipulators for QuicStreamFactory objects in Chromium's QUIC implementation.

methods.name: GetConfig
methods.description: Returns the QuicConfig associated with the given QuicStreamFactory.

methods.name: GetCryptoConfig
methods.description: Retrieves the crypto configuration handle for testing purposes.

methods.name: HasActiveSession
methods.description: Checks if there is an active session for the specified server and network anonymization key.

methods.name: HasActiveJob
methods.description: Checks if there is an active job for the specified server.

methods.name: GetPendingSession
methods.description: Retrieves the pending session associated with the specified server and destination.

methods.name: GetActiveSession
methods.description: Retrieves the active session for the specified server and network key.

methods.name: HasLiveSession
methods.description: Checks if a live session exists for the given destination and server.

methods.name: IsLiveSession
methods.description: Checks if the given session is currently live within the factory.

methods.name: SetTaskRunner
methods.description: Sets the task runner for the factory.

methods.name: SetTickClock
methods.description: Sets the tick clock for the factory.

methods.name: GetPingTimeout
methods.description: Returns the ping timeout value for the factory.

methods.name: SetYieldAfterPackets
methods.description: Sets the number of packets after which to yield in the factory.

methods.name: SetYieldAfterDuration
methods.description: Sets the duration after which to yield in the factory.

methods.name: CryptoConfigCacheIsEmpty
methods.description: Checks if the crypto config cache is empty for a given server and network key.

methods.name: CacheDummyServerConfig
methods.description: Caches a dummy server configuration for testing purposes.

methods.name: GetNumPushStreamsCreated
methods.description: Returns the number of push streams created by the factory.

methods.name: GetNumDegradingSessions
methods.description: Returns the number of degrading sessions monitored by the factory.

methods.name: SetAlarmFactory
methods.description: Sets the alarm factory for the QuicStreamFactory.
